First, I know that in any relationship, mutual respect is important. If Susan is asking her friends to do things her way, that might be okay if it's something minor and everyone is on board. But if she's pushing them to do something they're uncomfortable with, that's a problem. I remember reading about the concept of consent and autonomy. People have the right to make their own choices, even if it goes against what someone else wants. So if Susan is pressuring her friends, that's not cool. It's like taking away their freedom to decide for themselves. Also, there's the aspect of friendship. Friends usually support each other, but that doesn't mean they have to agree on everything. If Susan is trying to control her friends, it might damage the trust and closeness in the friendship. That's not a healthy dynamic.
